game: CHI @ LV Week 4 2025, kickoff 2025-09-28 16:25 ET, Allegiant dome, LV -1.5, total 47.5

script.base: Dome pick'em in all but name: LV -1.5, total 47.5, implied LV 24.5 / CHI 23.0. Neither side is priced for a blowout, so both QBs stay in a normal pass rate and both lead backs keep a full carry share. Jeanty (47 carries, 144 yards, 3.06 YPC over 3 games) gets about 15-16 carries including late snaps if LV is level or narrowly ahead; Swift splits with Monangai (13 carries) and Caleb Williams' 14 rushes, and CHI does not get a clock-killing lead.
script.flip1: CHI falls behind after a LV scoring burst. CHI abandons the run, so Swift's rush line dies and Odunze/Moore targets spike, while LV runs the clock with Jeanty and Meyers/Bowers/Tucker late volume stalls.
script.flip2: CHI jumps ahead or it becomes a shootout. LV abandons the run, Jeanty's carry over dies, and Geno Smith throws to Meyers, Bowers and Tucker; Swift can see a positive run script and threaten a rush under. A defensive slog is unlikely in a dome at 47.5, but Wright out plus LV's 29% blitz is the version that drags CHI's deep yards down.

Edwards Out (hamstring) both hit the run fit and the middle, so Jeanty's carries and any TE/RB checkdowns gain; backup names are not in the pack. CHI T Darnell Wright Out (elbow) raises pressure and cuts rushing efficiency, which hurts Swift and deep CHI WR yards and nudges quick throws. CHI RB D'Andre Swift Questionable (hip): if limited, Monangai (13/44, game log 0, 28, 16) is next man; if inactive, pull any Swift leg at the inactives checkpoint. CHI CB Kyler Gordon Questionable (hamstring) and TE Colston Loveland Questionable (hip) are not carded. LV TE Michael Mayer Out (concussion) had 7 targets / 47 yards in the 3-game sample, so Bowers (21/179) is the same-position beneficiary, but that is a sleeper check not a leg. LV CB Decamerion Richardson Questionable (hamstring) would help Odunze/Moore if he sits; not confirmed.

matchup.shell: MOFO/MOFC and man/zone charting are not in the pack. Location YPA is the proxy. LV: middle 11.06 YPA on 17 attempts, left 8.07 on 42, right 6.15 on 34 (the strong side). CHI: middle 10.05 on 21, left 8.29 on 35, right 7.24 on 37.
matchup.pressure: LV blitzes 29%; CHI EPA/dropback is 0.06 vs blitz and 0.20 vs no blitz, so pressure suppresses Chicago, and Wright being out amplifies it. CHI blitzes only 24%; LV EPA/dropback is 0.17 vs blitz but -0.04 with no blitz, so Las Vegas' base-script look has been the worse one.
matchup.bleeds: CHI run defense bleeds: 5.50 YPC allowed, 10 runs of 10+, plus 11 passes of 20+. LV run defense is tighter at 4.65 YPC and 8 runs of 10+, with 8 passes of 20+. Both secondaries bleed the middle more than the right side.
matchup.overlap: Core overlap is Jeanty, the 47-carry back, into a 5.50 YPC defense missing Jarrett and Edwards. Not carded: Bowers into CHI's middle with Edwards and Mayer out, because his log is 103, 38, 38 and LV has been negative EPA when not blitzed. Odunze (27 targets, 334 air yards, 12.4 aDOT) does not clearly attack LV's middle bleed, and the blitz/Wright pressure look cuts against a deep over.

form: Avoiding season-long myths; only weeks 1-3. Jeanty rush 38, 43, 63 (mean 48.0, median 43) on 47 carries; receiving 2, 1, 0 so he is not a pass-game back. White 8, -2, 19 on just 10 carries. Swift rush 53, 63, 33 (mean 49.7, median 53) on 42/149 (3.55 YPC); rush+rec 65, 69, 78; rec 12, 6, 45. Monangai rush 0, 28, 16. Odunze rec 37, 128, 62 on 27/227/334 air. Moore 57, 46, 21 on 16/124. Zaccheaus 42, 12, 24. Meyers 97, 68, 63 on 26/228. Bowers 103, 38, 38 on 21/179. Tucker 54, 12, 145. Thornton 45, 20, 29. The 128, 103 and 145 games are the fluky spikes; Jeanty's 38-43-63 is a real uptrend, Swift's 33 is the recent low.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and both legs lost. Jeanty finished under 43.5 because the 3.06 YPC traveled, CHI sold out to stop him with Jarrett's backup still holding the point of attack, and LV fell behind so the 47-carry role became 11 carries and a bunch of Geno dropbacks. Swift went over 53.5 because the questionable tag was a decoy, he played every early-down snap, Monangai stayed at 4 carries, and a close dome game let him stack the 63-yard script against a LV front that is only 4.65 YPC, not a shutdown unit. The same CHI-leads flip kills both: Jeanty's over needs LV not to trail big, and Swift's under needs CHI not to be the team running out the clock. If inactives show Swift out, the under was never a bet and Monangai was the live number instead.
slip_story: One story: Chicago's defense is the soft unit and Chicago's own run game is the compromised one. Stack Jeanty rush over with Swift rush under. They cash together if LV is level or ahead and CHI never gets a runaway ground script. Do not add CHI WR overs (they need the trail/shootout flip and face a 29% blitz with Wright out) and do not add a total under. No TDs, one market per player, two legs. Pull Swift at inactives if he is out; do not flip to Monangai over 16.5 unless that scratch is confirmed, because his median rush is 16 against a 16.5 line.
